definition: Sara Hooker is a computer scientist who works in the field of artificial intelligence (AI).
details: Led Cohere For AI; research on model efficiency and evaluation. She is known for her work on model efficiency at scale, large language models and areas of research on algorithmic bias and fairness in machine learning. In 2025, she co-founded Adaption, a startup focused on creating AI systems capable of continuous real-time learning and efficient adaptation.

explainer.lead: Sara Hooker is an Irish computer scientist.
explainer.knownFor: Notable works include A Benchmark for Interpretability Methods in Deep Neural Networks and computer hardware.

contributions.name: Hooker previously served as the Vice President of Research at Cohere, where she led the company's research arm, Cohere For AI, and launched the Cohere For AI scholars program.Prior to Cohere, she built large systems in computer vision and NLP at Google Deepmind.
She has received recognition including the ACL Best Paper Award for her scholarly contributions in natural language processing and machine learning. == References ==

timeline.what: In 2023, Hooker was listed as one of AI's top 13 innovators by Fortune.
